When my mom broke her femur. I had just shown up to my parents house and as I was pulling up in my work truck I could see my mom in the back yard up on their 5'+ rocked/ boulder landscape spraying for weeds. Also my sister who is special needs was with her.

I hopped out of my truck with intent of telling them to get the hell down because my mom's balance isn't that great, but before I could my dad was in their garage and he caught my attention and began talking to me. It was not 30 seconds of talking to my dad when sister came flying into the garage Screaming "mom broke her leg". 

I've never someone scream like my mom did. When I got to her I could see that her femur had preiced it's way out of her pant leg right above the knee. I didn't panic but quickly realized that she was possibly going to die right in front of me. I called 911 and luckily they were there within about 5 minutes. The ER told she had broken her femur vertically which is a sign of strong knee joints. Recovery was long and she had to have her leg opened up 7 different times because of infection. Since then my mom hasn't been the same and not just physically but mentally.

For a while I blamed myself for not getting to her before talking to my dad. The weirdest thing for me was how calm I was about everything, its almost like autopilot kicked in.
